description: This Java class 'AuthController' is a REST controller that provides authentication endpoints such as register, login, and retrieving current user info, using Spring Boot framework annotations and dependency injection.

classes.name: AuthController
classes.description: A REST controller class managing authentication-related endpoints for user registration, login, and fetching current user information.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creating a new user with a role and returning a JWT token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates an existing user and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user based on the provided security context.
